overview_description.description:
CIB is a financial service company that strives to provide superior financial solutions to meet all customers’ needs. It was formed as a joint venture between the National Bank of Egypt (NBE, 51%) and the Chase Manhattan Bank (49%) under the name "Chase National Bank of Egypt”. 

Having the strongest brand equity rightfully places CIB as the bank of choice for over 500 of Egypt’s largest corporations. CIB shows tremendous potential within the bourgeoning Retail and SME Banking markets. Through its superior management, high operating standards, corporate governance best practices, and training programs, CIB has succeeded in becoming the most profitable commercial bank operating in Egypt for more than 40 years.

It was established in 1975 and is based in Giza, Egypt.

product.name: Personal Banking

product.name: SME Banking

product.name: Cards and Payments
product.description: Debit, credit, and prepaid card services for purchases, cash withdrawals, online transactions, and merchant payments.

product.name: Digital Banking
product.description: Online and mobile banking channels for account access, transfers, bill payments, card management, and other banking transactions.

product.name: Wealth Management and Investment Services
product.description: Investment and advisory services for individuals and institutions, including portfolio management, investment products, and market-related solutions.
